BiblicalUsage: This word is a fault, a single error, and it cost Uzzah his life. The anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzzah, and God smote him there for his error, and he died by the ark of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe one error at the ark was enough, because God's holiness does not grade on a curve.
